name: The Reading Room
description: A sunlit, book-lined room tucked beside the heart of town. Settle in for a focused study session, a small reading circle, or a quiet afternoon with your ideas.

name: Coconut Grove Studio
description: A bright, modern studio with room to spread out. Bring a team together for a workshop, planning day, or a meeting that deserves more than a video call.

name: Seaside Thinkspace
description: A calm upstairs room with sea breezes and generous tables. Good for small workshops, collaborative study, and the kind of conversations that need a little space.

name: The Green Verandah
description: A leafy, covered verandah where the afternoon light does half the hosting. Gather your group for a slow brainstorm, a book club, or a little fresh-air focus.

name: Paper & Pine Workshop
description: A thoughtfully set-up workshop room made for sharing ideas and making things together. Everything is in reach, with a print shop and good coffee just outside.

name: Monsoon Meeting Loft
description: A polished, rain-friendly loft for focused team time. The fast Wi-Fi, flexible meeting layout, and proper presentation kit make it easy to get straight to work.

name: Blue Door Study Nook
description: An easy-on-the-budget nook for independent study, exam prep, or a quiet catch-up. Bring your notes, find your seat, and let the afternoon settle in.

name: Harbour Light Hall
description: A breezy, generous hall near the harbour, ready for talks, classes, and celebrations. A full presentation setup and easy entry make hosting feel simple.

name: Citrus Courtyard
description: A sunny courtyard with just enough shade and plenty of room for conversation. Gather for a casual workshop, a creative meetup, or a fresh-air study group.

name: The Corner Classroom
description: A welcoming learning room with a proper board, projector, and flexible chairs. Great for a peer-led class, study circle, or skills-sharing afternoon.

name: Palm & Chalk Rooftop
description: A rooftop hideaway with room for a lively gathering under the open sky. Best for golden-hour talks, community meetups, and ideas that need fresh air.

name: Little Lantern Cafe Room
description: A tucked-away cafe room with coffee on hand and a friendly hum beyond the door. A lovely change of scene for a small team, club, or creative catch-up.

name: Malabar Makers Room
description: A maker-minded room with flexible tables, dependable kit, and a host who knows the neighbourhood. Set up a hands-on session, a class, or a team jam.

name: Quiet Hours Study Hall
description: An affordable, spacious study hall where quiet is part of the welcome. Spread out with your books, meet a study partner, or stay for a long afternoon of focus.

name: The Assembly Room
description: A roomy, comfortable gathering place for team sessions, community talks, and shared plans. Practical meeting tools come with a warm, un-stuffy feel.

name: The Mango Tree Room
description: A peaceful garden room under the mango trees, with shade, water, and space to breathe. Host a book club, a small class, or an unhurried study group.

name: North Beach Commons
description: A comfortable, well-equipped meeting space near the coast. Fast Wi-Fi, power that stays on, and thoughtful hosting make full-team days feel easy.

name: Sandalwood Seminar Room
description: A calm seminar room with clear sightlines, a bright projector, and plenty of seats. Bring a lecture, a panel, or an all-hands session together in one place.

name: Rain Tree Reading Nook
description: A gentle little reading nook close to the beach, with soft chairs, good light, and no pressure to rush. Settle in to study or share a quiet conversation.

name: Common Ground Cafe Corner
description: A bright cafe corner with just the right amount of buzz. Meet a friend, host a tiny planning session, or find a new spot for your everyday work.

name: The Blue Bench Meeting Room
description: A focused, no-fuss room with a proper meeting table and a reliable setup. Make space for a planning session, mentoring circle, or a small team off-site.

name: Cloud Nine Lecture Room
description: A spacious lecture room for talks worth travelling to. Bright projection, accessible entry, and a welcoming neighbourhood make larger gatherings feel personal.

name: Little Fern Community Room
description: A friendly neighbourhood room where local groups meet, learn, and make plans. Flexible furniture, a helpful host, and a little tea make it easy to settle in.

name: The Study Garden
description: An easygoing garden study spot close to the sea. Affordable, quiet, and surrounded by leafy shade—just right for a long afternoon with books and friends.

name: Lanternlight Event Room
description: A beautiful, flexible hall for the big idea, the community gathering, or the celebration you've been planning. Full AV, kind hosting, and space to make it yours.
